_meta.definition: The process of managing the production lifecycle, including bill of materials, product cost history, list price history, work orders, and work order routing.

columns.name: BillOfMaterialsID
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in Production BillOfMaterials

columns.name: ProductAssemblyID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the Product Assembly entity

columns.name: ComponentID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the Component entity

columns.name: StartDate
columns.description: Stores the initial production date for each bill of materials.

columns.name: EndDate
columns.description: Stores planned end dates for production items.

columns.name: UnitMeasureCode
columns.description: Stores standard units of measure for each item in the production bill of materials (e.g., EA for Each).

columns.name: BOMLevel
columns.description: The BOMLevel column in Production BillOfMaterials stores the quantity of each component in a single product assembly.

columns.name: PerAssemblyQty
columns.description: Stores the quantity of assemblies produced per unit for each product.

columns.name: ModifiedDate
columns.description: Stores timestamps for the last modification of each record in the Production BillOfMaterials table (2010-02-18 format).

columns.name: ProductID
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in Production ProductCostHistory

columns.name: StartDate
columns.description: Stores the specific date when a product's cost history was initiated (e.g., 2013-05-30).

columns.name: EndDate
columns.description: Stores historical dates marking the end of cost records for production products.

columns.name: StandardCost
columns.description: Stores historical standard costs for individual production products.

columns.name: ModifiedDate
columns.description: Stores timestamps for when product cost history records were last modified (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss.fff format).

columns.name: ProductID
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in Production ProductListPriceHistory

columns.name: StartDate
columns.description: Stores the specific date when a product's list price history was initiated.

columns.name: EndDate
columns.description: Stores historical dates when product list prices were discontinued.

columns.name: ListPrice
columns.description: Stores historical unit prices for various products in the Production Product List Price History table.

columns.name: ModifiedDate
columns.description: Stores date and time of product list price modifications.

columns.name: WorkOrderID
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in Production WorkOrder

columns.name: ProductID
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in Production WorkOrder

columns.name: OrderQty
columns.description: Stores the quantity of work orders for each production instance.

columns.name: StockedQty
columns.description: StockedQty in Production WorkOrder stores the quantity of a product that is currently available.

columns.name: ScrappedQty
columns.description: Stores the quantity of work orders that have been scrapped.

columns.name: StartDate
columns.description: Stores formatted date and time for when a production work order was started.

columns.name: EndDate
columns.description: The Production WorkOrder's EndDate column stores scheduled completion dates for work orders.

columns.name: DueDate
columns.description: Stores scheduled production work completion dates in a YYYY-MM-DD format.

columns.name: ScrapReasonID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the Scrap Reason entity

columns.name: ModifiedDate
columns.description: Stores timestamp strings of when each work order was last modified.

columns.name: WorkOrderID
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in Production WorkOrderRouting

columns.name: ProductID
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in Production WorkOrderRouting

columns.name: OperationSequence
columns.description: Stores the sequential order of operations within a single work order for production.

columns.name: LocationID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the Location entity

columns.name: ScheduledStartDate
columns.description: Stores scheduled start dates for production work orders, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

columns.name: ScheduledEndDate
columns.description: Stores planned completion dates for various work orders in a sequence.

columns.name: ActualStartDate
columns.description: Stores actual start dates for individual work orders in production.

columns.name: ActualEndDate
columns.description: Stores the actual end dates for production work order routings as formatted timestamps (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.fff).

columns.name: ActualResourceHrs
columns.description: Stores actual hours of resource allocation for each work order routing step.

columns.name: PlannedCost
columns.description: Stores estimated production costs for each work order routing operation.

columns.name: ActualCost
columns.description: Stores the actual cost per work order routing operation.

columns.name: ModifiedDate
columns.description: Stores timestamps of work order routing modifications.
